lines.ja: やあ、私、山田と申します。
lines.speaker: Yamada

lines.ja: うわあ、すごく山田さんっぽい顔！
lines.en: Whoa, you have such a Yamada-looking face!
lines.speaker: Maruo

lines.ja: 丸男君、大問題が起きたんだよ。
lines.en: Maruo-kun, a big problem has occurred.
lines.speaker: Yamada

clips.title: Our Bird Escaped Because of Your Cat
grammar: 関係ない — have nothing to do with

lines.ja: 丸男君の猫は本当に悪い。
lines.en: Maruo-kun, your cat is really bad.
lines.speaker: Yamada

lines.ja: そうよ。今晩、焼き鳥にして食べる予定だったのに！
lines.en: That's right. Even though we were planning to eat it as yakitori tonight!
lines.speaker: Kawaguchi

lines.ja: 大、大、大、大、大問題じゃー！
lines.en: It's a huge, huge, huge, huge, huge problem!
lines.speaker: Ogawa

lines.en: Eh, that has nothing to do with me!
lines.speaker: Maruo

clips.title: Searching for the Bad Cat
grammar: 〜ちゃう — to end up doing / casually do

lines.ja: 焼き猫にして食べちゃう！
lines.en: We'll roast the cat and eat it up!
lines.speaker: Kawaguchi

lines.ja: 焼き猫、ごちそうじゃー！
lines.speaker: Ogawa

lines.ja: えーっ、僕の猫、焼いて食べる？
lines.en: What? You're going to roast and eat my cat?
lines.speaker: Maruo

lines.ja: よし、悪い猫を探しに、レッツゴー！
lines.en: Alright, let's go search for that bad cat!
lines.speaker: Yamada

lines.ja: ３人は猫を探しに外へ走っていきました。
lines.en: The three ran outside to look for the cat.
lines.speaker: Narrator
